items.title: Elastic Security integration with Google Distributed Cloud: Closing the velocity gap in air-gapped environments
items.summary: As AI-powered threats grow more complex, traditional security operations struggle to keep pace. Google Distributed Cloud AI SecOps, powered by Elastic, brings AI-driven detection, investigation, and response to fully air-gapped environments.
items.creator: TJ Banasik, Google Distribution Cloud,Mike Nichols
